classes.name: TDataXtd_Constraint
classes.summary:
The groundwork to define constraint attributes. The constraint attribute contains the following sorts of data:
- Type whether the constraint attribute is a geometric constraint or a dimension
- Value the real number value of a numeric constraint such as an angle or a radius
- Geometries to identify the geometries underlying the topological attributes which define the constraint (up to 4)
- Plane for 2D constraints.

staticMethods.name: GetID
staticMethods.comment: Returns the GUID for constraints.

staticMethods.name: Set
staticMethods.comment:
Finds or creates the 2D constraint attribute defined by the planar topological attribute plane and the label label.
**Constraint methods**

staticMethods.name: CollectChildConstraints
staticMethods.comment:
collects constraints on Childs for label <aLabel>
@param TheList Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Finds or creates the constraint attribute defined by the topological attribute G1 and the constraint type type.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.signature: (type_: TDataXtd_ConstraintEnum, G1: TNaming_NamedShape, G2: TNaming_NamedShape): void
instanceMethods.comment: Finds or creates the constraint attribute defined by the topological attributes G1 and G2, and by the constraint type type.

instanceMethods.name: Set

instanceMethods.comment:

**methods to read constraint fields**

instanceMethods.name: Verified
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this constraint attribute is valid. By default, true is returned. When the value of a dimension is changed or when a geometry is moved, false is returned until the solver sets it back to true.

instanceMethods.name: Verified
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this constraint attribute defined by status is valid. By default, true is returned. When the value of a dimension is changed or when a geometry is moved, false is returned until the solver sets it back to true. If status is false, Verified is set to false.

instanceMethods.name: GetType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type of constraint. This will be an element of the `TDataXtd_ConstraintEnum` enumeration.

instanceMethods.name: IsPlanar
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this constraint attribute is two-dimensional.

instanceMethods.name: GetPlane
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the topological attribute of the plane used for planar - i.e., 2D - constraints. This plane is attached to another label. If the constraint is not planar, in other words, 3D, this function will return a null handle.

instanceMethods.name: IsDimension
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this constraint attribute is a dimension, and therefore has a value.

instanceMethods.name: GetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of a dimension. This value is a reference to a {@link TDataStd_Real | `TDataStd_Real`} attribute. If the attribute is not a dimension, this value will be 0. Use IsDimension to test this condition.

instanceMethods.name: NbGeometries
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of geometry attributes in this constraint attribute. This number will be between 1 and 4.

instanceMethods.name: GetGeometry
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the integer index Index used to access the array of the constraint or stored geometries of a dimension Index has a value between 1 and 4.
**methods to write constraint fields (use builder)**

instanceMethods.name: ClearGeometries
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the geometries involved in the constraint or dimension from the array of topological attributes where they are stored.

instanceMethods.name: SetType
instanceMethods.comment: Finds or creates the type of constraint CTR.

instanceMethods.name: SetPlane
instanceMethods.comment: Finds or creates the plane of the 2D constraint attribute, defined by the planar topological attribute plane.

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Finds or creates the real number value V of the dimension constraint attribute.

instanceMethods.name: SetGeometry
instanceMethods.comment: Finds or creates the underlying geometry of the constraint defined by the topological attribute G and the integer index Index.

instanceMethods.name: ID
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the ID of the attribute.

instanceMethods.name: Restore
instanceMethods.comment: Restores the backuped contents from <anAttribute> into this one. It is used when aborting a transaction.

instanceMethods.name: NewEmpty
instanceMethods.comment: Returns an new empty attribute from the good end type. It is used by the copy algorithm.

instanceMethods.name: Paste
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is different from the "Copy" one, because it is used when copying an attribute from a source structure into a target structure. This method may paste the contents of <me> into <intoAttribute>.
The given pasted attribute can be full or empty of its contents. But don't make a NEW! Just set the contents!
It is possible to use <aRelocationTable> to get/set the relocation value of a source attribute.

instanceMethods.name: References
instanceMethods.comment:
Adds the first level referenced attributes and labels to <aDataSet>.
For this, use the AddLabel or AddAttribute of DataSet.
If there is none, do not implement the method.

classes.name: TDataXtd_Triangulation
classes.summary: An Ocaf attribute containing a mesh ({@link Poly_Triangulation | `Poly_Triangulation`}). It duplicates all methods from {@link Poly_Triangulation | `Poly_Triangulation`}. It is highly recommended to modify the mesh through the methods of this attribute, but not directly via the underlying {@link Poly_Triangulation | `Poly_Triangulation`} object. In this case Undo/Redo will work fine and robust.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment:
Object methods.
A constructor. Don't use it directly, use please the static method `Set()`, which returns the attribute attached to a label.

staticMethods.comment:

Returns the ID of the triangulation attribute.

instanceMethods.name: Get
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the underlying triangulation.

instanceMethods.name: Deflection
instanceMethods.comment:
{@link Poly_Triangulation | `Poly_Triangulation`} methods.
The methods are "covered" by this attribute to prevent direct modification of the mesh. There is no performance problem to call {@link Poly_Triangulation | `Poly_Triangulation`} method through this attribute. The most of the methods are considered as "inline" by the compiler in release mode. Returns the deflection of this triangulation.
